Write one short, deliberately under-specified user question, at most 10 words. Use the unresolved pronoun it or them. Follow the requested intent. Never identify what it or them refers to. Do not include a policy name, equipment name, item code, location, date, or factual details. A reader must ask what the user means. Vary the intent from previous questions. Return only {"question":"..."}.

Return JSON matching this example shape: {"question": ""}

message.content: {"question": "What is the cost of it or them?"}
